messages.content: i say there are only two cups in my bag. then i say there are three cups in that same bag at the same time. can both be right?
not if both are about all the cups in the same bag at the same time. only two and three are not the same number.
i really have three. fix the first sentence.
there are three cups in my bag.
just the number in the fixed sentence.
three.
i had two books yesterday and three today. can that be true?
no. you could get another book between yesterday and today.
i did get one from my mother.
then two yesterday and three today can both be true, because you got one more.
how many did i get from her?
one book.
my sister says my coat is in the house. i found it in the bedroom. was she wrong?
not if the bedroom is in the house. the bedroom is a place inside the house.
it is our bedroom inside our house.
then both things can be true.
which answer would help me find it?
if she says the bedroom, you know which room to look in. in the house does not say which room.
i need to carry water. should i use a cup or a book?
a cup. it can hold water, and a book is for reading.
i only need a little water for me.
a cup can work for that.
just the thing to use.
a cup.
a spoon helps me eat soup. what helps me write, a pen or a plate?
a pen helps you write.
and which can hold my lunch?
a plate.
do i use the same thing for both things i want to do?
no. you use a pen for writing and a plate for lunch.
my brother is holding my camera while i put my coat on. is it my camera or his camera?
it is your camera. your brother is holding it for you.
does holding it make it his?
no. holding your camera does not make it his.
what should he give back when i am ready?
your camera.
what can i say to my friend who just came home?
welcome home. it is nice to see you.
do not add a story about where she went.
welcome home. it is nice to see you.
can it be just two words?
welcome home.
i feel happy and calm after sitting in the garden. help me write that in a simple way.
i feel happy and calm after sitting in the garden.
shorter, please.
the garden helps me feel calm and happy.
do not tell me to go there every day.
the garden helps me feel calm and happy.
my father is a teacher. does that tell you where he is now?
no. being a teacher does not tell me his place right now.
he is at home today.
then you said he is at home today.
does that mean he is not a teacher now?
no. being at home today does not mean he is not a teacher.
i brought a coat because it is cold. why did i bring it? keep it short.
because it is cold.
did i say i brought it because of rain?
no. you said because it is cold.
just the reason again.
it is cold.
write you have my book as a kind question.
could you please tell me if you have my book?
make it shorter, but keep it a question.
do you have my book?
just that question.
do you have my book?
i finished washing the clothes. i am tired and want to rest.
you can rest after the work you finished.
i also had an idea about cleaning the floor, but i did not say i would do it today.
thinking about it does not mean you have to add it to today.
what did i finish?
washing the clothes.
write a sentence about a boy reading at the station.
a boy read a book at the station.
make him waiting for his father, not reading.
a boy waited for his father at the station.
did you change the place?
no. he is still at the station.
i have three red pens and two blue pens. how many red pens?
three red pens.
now count all the pens together.
five pens.
how many were blue?
two.
i hope my friend will visit. does that say i know she is coming?
no. it says you want her to visit, not that you know she will.
can you write a note that keeps hope?
i hope you can visit.
did you say she already said yes?
no.
what does enough mean with chairs and people?
if each person can have a chair, there are enough chairs for them to sit.
i have three people and two chairs. enough for one each?
no. you need one more chair.
what if i get one more?
then you have three chairs, enough for the three people to have one each.
give me one idea for a picture. it must have a green tree and no house.
a green tree by a little blue boat.
can i add a bird?
yes. you can add a bird in the green tree.
should you add a house now too?
no. you asked for no house.
picoboi, how do you know i have a red bag?
you said red bag here. i can use your words, but i cannot see the bag.
i did tell you in my last sentence. can you remember the color now?
red.
does that mean you saw a photo?
no. i got it from your words.
i want to talk with my grandfather about his day. what can i ask?
what did you enjoy today?
can i ask about his garden instead?
what do you grow in your garden now?
just that garden question.
what do you grow in your garden now?
write i will return your cup tomorrow.
i will return your cup tomorrow.
only change cup to bowl.
i will return your bowl tomorrow.
what did you keep?
you will return it tomorrow.
i am waiting for my sister. can we talk while i wait?
yes. what would you like to talk about?
i want to tell you about the book i read.
what did you enjoy about it?
i like the girl in the story. do you know when my sister will come?
no. you have not said when she will come.
my friend would like me to play now, but i need to study. write a short no.
sorry, i need to study now.
add that i like the game.
i like the game, but i need to study now.
do not say i can play later for sure.
i like the game, but i need to study now.
a cup is on a table inside the kitchen. is the cup inside the kitchen too?
yes. if the table and cup are inside the kitchen, the cup is inside it.
does that mean it is inside the table?
no. you said it is on the table, not inside the table.
just the room where it is.
the kitchen.
i washed my hands, ate lunch, and then read a page. what did i do last?
you read a page.
did i eat after reading?
no. you said you ate before reading.
just what came first.
washing your hands.
is the opposite of above below?
yes. below is the opposite of above.
just say below once.
below.
thanks, that is all for now.
you are welcome.
